exposure: ratio of weight gain to pre-pregnancy weight
cohort: Seven hundred and twenty women in China who attempted a trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC) were enrolled.
finding: The study developed and validated an improved prediction model for vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC) in a Chinese population, with 81.4% of participants achieving VBAC.
mod_finding: The developed model exhibited good performance in predicting VBAC, identifying factors like previous vaginal delivery, spontaneous labor onset, pregnancy interval, and ratio of weight gain to pre-pregnancy weight as key predictors influencing the likelihood of successful vaginal birth after cesarean.
